results.final_sql: WITH paid_current AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Medicare Part B North Carolina' AND paid_amount > 0 ), answer AS ( SELECT round(avg(paid_amount), 2) AS avg_paid_amount FROM paid_current ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_primary AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_class, service_date_from FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND is_latest_submission ), first_submission AS ( SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission_date FROM sem.claims WHERE claim_key IN (SELECT claim_key FROM latest_primary) GROUP BY claim_key ), claim_lag AS ( SELECT latest_primary.claim_key, latest_primary.payer_class, date_diff('day', latest_primary.service_date_from, first_submission.first_submission_date) AS lag_days FROM latest_primary INNER JOIN first_submission ON latest_primary.claim_key = first_submission.claim_key ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS claim_count, round(avg(lag_days), 2) AS avg_lag_days, median(lag_days) AS median_lag_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lag_days > 90) AS claims_lag_over_90 FROM claim_lag GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount, remit_line_id FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ), answer AS ( SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483') / sum(line_paid_amount), 4) AS g0483_share FROM current_lines ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH replacements AS ( SELECT claim_id, submission_month, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' ), answer AS ( SELECT submission_month, count(*) AS replacement_claim_count, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS total_billed_charge FROM replacements GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_primary AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND is_latest_submission ), first_submission_to_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission_date FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), current_paid AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payment_date FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount > 0 ), paid_primary AS ( SELECT latest_primary.claim_key, latest_primary.payer_class, date_diff('day', first_submission_to_payer.first_submission_date, current_paid.payment_date) AS days_to_pay FROM latest_primary INNER JOIN current_paid ON latest_primary.claim_key = current_paid.claim_key AND latest_primary.payer_key = current_paid.payer_key INNER JOIN first_submission_to_payer ON latest_primary.claim_key = first_submission_to_payer.claim_key AND latest_primary.payer_key = first_submission_to_payer.payer_key ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claim_count, round(median(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days_to_pay, round(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days_to_pay FROM paid_primary GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH denied_current AS ( SELECT remit_claim_id, claim_key, payer_key, claim_payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied ), co_denial_adjustments AS ( SELECT adjustments.carc_code, denied_current.claim_key, denied_current.payer_key FROM sem.adjustments INNER JOIN denied_current ON adjustments.remit_claim_id = denied_current.remit_claim_id WHERE adjustments.is_current_adjudication AND adjustments.group_code = 'CO' AND adjustments.is_denial_carc ), carc_pairs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT carc_code, claim_key, payer_key FROM co_denial_adjustments ), answer AS ( SELECT carc_code, count(*) AS denied_claim_payer_count FROM carc_pairs GROUP BY carc_code ORDER BY denied_claim_payer_count DESC, carc_code ASC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH current_medicaid_mco AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_class = 'medicaid_mco' ), answer AS ( SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) * 1.0 / count(*), 4) AS denial_rate FROM current_medicaid_mco ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH remit_events AS ( SELECT remit_claim_id, claim_payer_key, payer_class, is_current_adjudication, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims ), pairs AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, count(*) AS event_count, min(payer_class) AS payer_class, CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 AND bool_and(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_first_pass FROM remit_events GROUP BY claim_payer_key ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pair_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_first_pass) AS first_pass_resolved_count, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_first_pass) / count(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct FROM pairs GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH denied_current AS ( SELECT remit_claim_id, claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied ), co_denial_adjustments AS ( SELECT adjustments.carc_code, denied_current.claim_key, denied_current.payer_key, adjustments.adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments INNER JOIN denied_current ON adjustments.remit_claim_id = denied_current.remit_claim_id WHERE adjustments.is_current_adjudication AND adjustments.group_code = 'CO' AND adjustments.is_denial_carc ), answer AS ( SELECT carc_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key || '|' || payer_key) AS denied_claim_payer_count, round(sum(adjustment_amount), 2) AS total_co_adjustment_amount FROM co_denial_adjustments GROUP BY carc_code ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_claim_procedures AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_lines.claim_key, claim_lines.procedure_code, claims.principal_diagnosis_code FROM sem.claim_lines INNER JOIN sem.claims ON claim_lines.claim_key = claims.claim_key WHERE claim_lines.is_latest_submission AND claims.is_latest_submission ), procedure_dx_counts AS ( SELECT procedure_code, principal_diagnosis_code, count(*) AS claim_count FROM latest_claim_procedures GROUP BY procedure_code, principal_diagnosis_code ), procedure_totals AS ( SELECT procedure_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS claims_with_procedure FROM latest_claim_procedures GROUP BY procedure_code ), top_dx AS ( SELECT procedure_code, principal_diagnosis_code, claim_count FROM procedure_dx_counts QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_code ORDER BY claim_count DESC, principal_diagnosis_code ASC NULLS LAST) = 1 ), answer AS ( SELECT top_dx.procedure_code, top_dx.principal_diagnosis_code AS top_principal_diagnosis_code, top_dx.claim_count AS claims_with_top_diagnosis, procedure_totals.claims_with_procedure, round(100.0 * top_dx.claim_count / procedure_totals.claims_with_procedure, 1) AS top_diagnosis_share_percent FROM top_dx INNER JOIN procedure_totals ON top_dx.procedure_code = procedure_totals.procedure_code ORDER BY top_dx.procedure_code ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH current_adjudications AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ), answer AS ( SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) * 1.0 / count(*), 4) AS denial_rate FROM current_adjudications ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH remit_events AS ( SELECT remit_claim_id, claim_key, payer_key, claim_payer_key, payer_class, check_or_eft_number, is_reversal, is_current_adjudication, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims ), pairs AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS distinct_trace_count, bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current, coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS current_paid, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class FROM remit_events GROUP BY claim_payer_key ), multi_trace AS ( SELECT payer_class, has_reversal, has_current, current_paid FROM pairs WHERE distinct_trace_count >= 2 ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pair_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS pairs_with_no_current_adjudication_count, round(sum(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid_amount FROM multi_trace GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_claims AS ( SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission ), answer AS ( SELECT line_count, count(*) AS claim_count, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS share_percent, round(avg(charge_amount), 2) AS avg_billed_charge FROM latest_claims GROUP BY line_count ORDER BY line_count ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH non_denied_current AS ( SELECT remit_claim_id FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied = false ), partial_denied_lines AS ( SELECT rl.remit_line_id FROM sem.remit_lines rl INNER JOIN non_denied_current ndc ON rl.remit_claim_id = ndc.remit_claim_id WHERE rl.is_current_adjudication AND rl.line_is_denied ), answer AS (SELECT count(*) AS partial_denied_line_count FROM partial_denied_lines) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH primary_pairs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ), current_primary_remits AS ( SELECT rc.remit_claim_id, rc.claim_payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims rc INNER JOIN primary_pairs pp ON rc.claim_key = pp.claim_key AND rc.payer_key = pp.payer_key WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication ), pr1_adjustments AS ( SELECT a.adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments a INNER JOIN current_primary_remits cpr ON a.remit_claim_id = cpr.remit_claim_id WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1' ), answer AS (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(adjustment_amount), 0), 2) AS total_deductible FROM pr1_adjustments) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH current_adjudications AS ( SELECT claim_payer_key, payer_class, charge_amount, paid_amount, coalesce(patient_responsibility_amount, 0) AS patient_responsibility_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ), grouped AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS current_adjudication_count, sum(charge_amount) AS total_billed_charge, sum(paid_amount) AS total_paid, sum(patient_responsibility_amount) AS total_patient_responsibility FROM current_adjudications GROUP BY payer_class ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, current_adjudication_count, round(total_billed_charge, 2) AS total_billed_charge, round(total_paid, 2) AS total_paid, round(total_patient_responsibility, 2) AS total_patient_responsibility, round(100.0 * total_paid / nullif(total_billed_charge, 0), 1) AS paid_percent_of_billed, round(100.0 * total_patient_responsibility / nullif(total_billed_charge, 0), 1) AS patient_responsibility_percent_of_billed FROM grouped ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH void_submissions AS ( SELECT claim_id, claim_key FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8' ), answer AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS voided_claim_count FROM void_submissions) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH denied_36415_lines AS ( SELECT remit_line_id FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND procedure_code = '36415' AND line_is_denied ), answer AS (SELECT count(*) AS denied_line_count FROM denied_36415_lines) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_from_june AS ( SELECT claim_key, service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01' ), npi_counts AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS claim_count FROM latest_from_june GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi ), ranked AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, claim_count, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY claim_count DESC, referring_npi ASC) AS rn FROM npi_counts ), answer AS ( SELECT service_month, sum(claim_count) AS total_claims, sum(claim_count) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 5) AS top5_claims, round(100.0 * sum(claim_count) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 5) / sum(claim_count), 1) AS top5_share_percent FROM ranked GROUP BY service_month ORDER BY service_month ) SELECT * FROM answer

WITH latest_primary AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND is_latest_submission ), grouped AS ( SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS claim_count, sum(charge_amount) AS billed_charge FROM latest_primary GROUP BY payer_class ), answer AS ( SELECT payer_class, claim_count, round(100.0 * claim_count / sum(claim_count) OVER (), 1) AS percent_of_claims, round(billed_charge, 2) AS billed_charge, round(100.0 * billed_charge / sum(billed_charge) OVER (), 1) AS percent_of_billed_charge FROM grouped ORDER BY payer_class ) SELECT * FROM answer
